title: Revoke the stale client and run stopped-profile recovery on the service host
goal: The live service has no unused native client and its recovery path is verified on the host itself
acceptance: The 2026-11-07 client is revoked; the current companion still connects
Stopped-profile rotation on the service host keeps data, changes identity and pin, and the companion recovers by pairing again
privacy: No credential, ticket or token in Git or logs; evidence names client IDs only.
validation: Owner-observed live check recorded in docs/acceptance
escalation: Anything that would replace the live root credential goes to the owner first

effort.basis: Estimated 2026-11-13: one revoke and one documented rotation, owner-run. Not a measurement.
